configuration_identity.disclosure: OSM relation is explicitly dated 1971-1991; the operator confirms the Inner Loop was added only in 1992. Published length is the operator's rounded 3.4-mile Grand Prix-course value.

Current-source Grand Prix Strecke artwork only; it is not the Nordschleife, is not a 2013 context reconstruction, and is not presented as the 1976 configuration.
The operator records the Melbourne Loop from 1985 and the 1993 F1 event; this is current-source reference artwork, current OSM names are current labels, and the post-2010 rebuild is disclosed.

events.circuit_name: Canadian Tire Motorsport Park Grand Prix Circuit

configuration_identity.disclosure: The operator identifies the same 2.459-mile Grand Prix circuit as opening in 1961; later resurfacing and runoff works are not represented as period context.

events.circuit_name: Bahrain International Circuit Grand Prix Track

configuration_identity.disclosure: The operator and 2025 Formula 1 race page identify the 5.412 km Grand Prix Track; the frozen centreline is assembled only from OSM ways tagged Grand Prix Circuit. Current surroundings are not backdated.

Current OSM ways assemble the tagged 6.19 km Jeddah course within the 1.0% length gate. This is current-source reference artwork, not a period reconstruction; one shared selected segment retains an OSM Formula E fixme and is not treated as official configuration evidence.

events.event_identity: Current Nordschleife / 1976 German Grand Prix reference

configuration_identity.disclosure: This plate shows the operator's current 20.832 km Nordschleife as current-source reference artwork for the last 1976 F1 venue. The operator states that the course was shortened after the F1 era, so this is expressly not the 1976 configuration.

events.event_identity: Current Brands Hatch Grand Prix course / 1986 F1 reference
events.circuit_name: Brands Hatch Grand Prix Circuit (current course)

configuration_identity.disclosure: The current 3.916 km Grand Prix course is shown only as reference artwork for the 1986 F1 venue. It includes post-F1 revisions and is not represented as the 1986 configuration.

events.event_identity: Current Estoril course / 1996 Portuguese Grand Prix reference

configuration_identity.disclosure: The operator's current 4,182.72 m centreline is shown only as current-source reference artwork for the 1996 F1 venue; no equivalence to the 1996 course or context is claimed.

events.event_identity: Current Kyalami Grand Prix course / 1993 F1 reference

configuration_identity.disclosure: The current 4.522 km, 16-turn course is shown only as current-source reference artwork for Kyalami's final 1993 F1 season. It is not represented as the materially different 1993 configuration.
The mapped F1 trace has an 8.1 m topological gap and is not closed by inference.
